scope: original eight logical ranks; CPU semantic counts only; no physical GPU timing or bandwidth estimate

protocol.native_rt0: popularity retention disabled; balancing-required remote copies retained
protocol.native_rt2: two source-popularity retention choices per rank before balancing; shared B=8 cap
protocol.optimized: rt0 seed, reciprocal sampled residency, four global bundle-exchange rounds

copy_transfer_interpretation.unit: one complete selected remote expert copied from its original home into one rank's extra slot
copy_transfer_interpretation.full_refresh: counts apply once per prefetch invocation per layer when every selected expert is refreshed
copy_transfer_interpretation.home_weights: 44 original home experts per rank are parameters already resident; no extra copy charge
copy_transfer_interpretation.extra_slots: B additional prefetch slots per rank, backed by a process-global pool shared across layers, not persistent per-layer replicas
copy_transfer_interpretation.implementation: prefetch compacts every experts_to_copy>=0 entry and copies every tile; no ID/version cache test
copy_transfer_interpretation.optimizer_update: not necessarily one copy per optimizer update; microbatches, forward recomputation, prefetch invocation schedule and weight versions are external
copy_transfer_interpretation.reuse: zero-copy-cost reuse requires retained correct layer/expert/slot/version contents and explicitly skipping prefetch; not established by one router dump
copy_transfer_interpretation.shape: router dump contains no weights; counts deliberately do not assume H, intermediate size, dtype, gradients or bandwidth
